title: u32 byte ranges: intentional API change not documented in CHANGELOG
description: ParsedPart.header_range and body_range changed from (usize, usize) to (u32, u32). The rationale is documented in a doc comment on ParsedPart but there is no CHANGELOG file anywhere in the workspace. For a published crate, a breaking API change with no CHANGELOG means consumers upgrading have no machine-readable signal. Maintenance consequence: no CHANGELOG means the maintainer must inspect git log to understand version-to-version API changes, and crates.io users have no release notes to consult.
